title: Lifecycle tissue engineering: An AI-enabled multimodal sensing and digital twin roadmap

sections.title: 研究问题
sections.text:
《Lifecycle tissue engineering: An AI-enabled multimodal sensing and digital twin roadmap》：研究问题的原文依据。

【Abstract · abstract-1-1】The clinical translation of tissue engineering (TE) is critically hampered by the absence of real-time, non-invasive monitoring throughout the entire lifecycle of tissue fabrication and repair.
